records.detail: this module's licence row records that its ClinVar annotations were drafted from clinvar_2026-06-27, the very snapshot this check reads, so every authored clin_sig is a copy of the value it would be compared against. Two things that leaves unseen: a cell edited by hand since the draft, and rows added from another release. Re-run with --strict to look every row up and report which values are still copies, which a human wrote, and which conflict
no authored ref disagreed with the reference, so no row needed a build diagnosis
